The Browning Hi-Power is a single-action, semi-automatic pistol available in the 9x19mm Parabellum and .40 S&W calibers. It was based on a design by American firearms inventor John Browning, and completed by Dieudonne Saive at FN Herstal. Browning died in 1926, several years before the design was finalized. FN Herstal named it the "High Power" in allusion to the 13-round magazine capacity, almost twice that of other designs at the time, such as the Walther P38 or Colt M1911.
 
 %c[ui_gray_2]ATTACHMENTS: 
 %c[d_purple] • %c[ui_gray_2] 9x19 compatible suppressor (after modification)

Built off of the Shadow Systems CR920, an American made, compact, optics-ready 9mm pistol known for its reliability and modularity, "Shadow" found its way into the Zone after a black market arms deal gone wrong in Limansk between rogue Mercs and Monolith conscripts. Soon, a firefight broke out when a group of stalkers showed up to try to get their hands on rare goods, the CR920 remained where the arms deal went down, on a crate in the Limansk Construction Site.
 
 %c[ui_gray_2]ATTACHMENTS: 
 %c[d_purple] • %c[ui_gray_2] Gemtech Suppressor

The Fort-14 pistol is a sturdy, no-frills 9mm sidearm beloved for its simplicity and reliability. This weapon is a common, budget-friendly pistol carried by rookie stalkers and is easy to maintain and dependable when you need it.
 
 %c[ui_gray_2]ATTACHMENTS: 
 %c[d_purple] • %c[ui_gray_2] 9x19 compatible suppressor (after modification)

A unique version of the rugged Fort14 pistol, the "Blood Oath" was built out by elite Monolith forces who wanted more stopping power with the same reliability of the original. Coming chambered in 9x21, this handgun is sure to chew through anyone or anything unfortunate enough to find itself on the businesss end.
 
 %c[ui_gray_2]ATTACHMENTS: 
 %c[d_purple] • %c[ui_gray_2] 9x19 compatible suppressor (after modification)

The Walther PDP, a modern German sidearm known for its precision and ergonomics, found its way into the Zone through black market arms deals catering to mercenaries and well-equipped stalkers seeking reliable firepower.
 
 %c[ui_gray_2]ATTACHMENTS: 
 %c[d_purple] • %c[ui_gray_2] 9x19 compatible suppressor

The Walther PPQ Q5 Match is a precision-focused 9mm handgun built for speed and accuracy with a crisp trigger and optics-ready slide. This weapon is a high-end sidearm favored by elite stalkers—offering exceptional handling and accuracy.
 
 %c[ui_gray_2]ATTACHMENTS: 
 %c[d_purple] • %c[ui_gray_2] 9x19 compatible suppressor

Built upon the already match grade Q5, "Cinder" boasts a polished chamber and precision machined barrel, further increasing the stellar accuracy and speed of the base weapon. This special variant can be found in the hands of elite stalkers.
 
 %c[ui_gray_2]ATTACHMENTS: 
 %c[d_purple] • %c[ui_gray_2] 9x19 compatible suppressor

The Staccato USMS is a powerful, custom-modified pistol favored by elite operatives for its reliability and stopping power. It made its way into the Zone through black market arms deals and was quickly adopted by seasoned stalkers seeking an edge in the lawless, mutated wasteland.
 
 %c[ui_gray_2]ATTACHMENTS: 
 %c[d_purple] • %c[ui_gray_2] 9x19 compatible suppressor

A unique build for the Staccato USMS, "Liberty" sports a caliber change to .45 ACP, as well as a compensator to tame the stiffer recoil and comes equipped with a Leupold Deltapoint Pro for fast target aquisition.
 
 %c[ui_gray_2]ATTACHMENTS: 
 %c[d_purple] • %c[ui_gray_2] .45acp Suppressor

The Heckler & Koch USP45 is a rugged .45 ACP handgun known for its durability, reliability, and strong stopping power. "Phantom Mark" is a further customized version of the original, sporting a tan frame and greater compatibility with modern optics.
